question: Who among the following Vijayanagara kings defeated the Sultan of Bijapur in 1520?
solution:
__
 
• **Krishnadeva Raya**__ defeated the Sultan of Bijapur in 1520 in** ****Battle of Raichur**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

**Political consequences**

__
 
• The Vijayanagara victory weakened the power and prestige of the Adil Shah.
 
• He turned his attention to making alliances with the other Muslim neighbours.
 
• The victory also caused other Sultans in Deccan to form an alliance to defeat the Vijayanagar Empire
 
• The war also affected the fortunes of the Portuguese on the west coast.
 
• Goa rose and fell simultaneously with the rise and fall of the Vijayanagar dynasty because their entire trade depended on Hindu support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**** Battle of Raichur**

__
 
• The battle was fought in Raichur between the armies of** Krishnadevaraya** and the **Sultanate of Bijapur**
 
• Main commander of the Vijayanagara army was **Saluva Timmarusu also known as Saluva Timma**.
 
• Portuguese accounts state that **cannons** were used extensively by the **Bijapur Sultanate**
 
• The Vijayanagara Empire** emerged victorious** despite the Bijapur Sultanate having superior firepower.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishnadeva Raya** was the emperor of the Vijayanagar Empire.
 
• He was the t**hird ruler of the Tuluva Dynasty** and is considered to be the greatest ruler of this dynasty.
 
• He controlled the largest empire in India after the decline of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He was the person to rule his Empire over 500 years ago.
 
• He was one of the most powerful Hindu rulers in India and had the most extensive empire in the subcontinent.
 
• Portuguese travellers **Domingo Paes and Fernao Nuniz** also visited the Vijayanagara Empire during his rule.
 
• Krishnadeva Raya composed the** Amuktamalyada**, a work on statecraft in Telugu.
 
• He is known to have patronised poets and issued inscriptions in languages as varied as Sanskrit, Tamil, Kannada and Telugu. 
 
• His Sanskrit works include ‘**Madalasa Charita’, ‘Satyavadu Parinaya’, ‘Rasamanjari’ and ‘Jambavati Kalyana’.**
